public.text: The document runs to 254 pages and its most consequential content - the governance principles, the component boundary, the financing guidance and the legal dimension - is distributed across chapters 3 and 4. Ministers and finance officials will not read it, and the officials who brief them need a version that can be acted on.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a decision document at the front of no more than four to six pages, setting out the decisions a country has to take rather than summarising the guidance: what to designate as DPI-H; who operates each component; whether participation is obligatory; how it is financed and by whom the price is set; who enforces and with what sanctions; and where disputes are resolved. Each with the instrument, the deciding body and an indicative sequence. The present executive summary describes the document; a decision document would describe the choices.
